observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall with tiled floor, arched windows with glass doors at the back, and a red curtain to the right
observation.formation_and_space: staggered rows facing away initially, then turning to face forward in lines or a diagonal formation
observation.posture: upright torso with soft knees, weight shifting between feet
observation.footwork: small side-to-side steps and weight transfers on the beat; exact foot details obscured by long dress skirts
observation.arms_and_hands: arms extended sideways or raised overhead with wide flowing sleeves, hands fluttering and manipulating the sleeve fabric
observation.hips_and_torso: gentle side-to-side hip sways and torso undulations
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent torso dips forward and backward, spinning turns, and kneeling on the floor
observation.costume_and_props: long blue dresses with wide bell sleeves and ornate metallic waist belts
observation.cannot_infer: exact foot placement and weight transfer obscured by long dress skirts; rapid camera cuts and low video resolution limit fine detail

signature_moments.what: dancers raise arms overhead with wide sleeves framing their backs while swaying slightly
dancers whip their long hair forward and down in unison
group turns in place while extending arms and rippling sleeves outward
dancers dip torsos backward while whipping hair in a circle
